exposure: bladder neck-symphysis distance during the Valsalva manoeuvre
retrovesical angle during the Valsalva manoeuvre
abnormal fatigue degree of type II muscle fibres
cohort: A total of 530 subjects were enrolled, who had clinical, ultrasonographic, and myoelectric data collected for the evaluation of postpartum SUI.
finding: Maternal age, BMI, hypertension, parity, specific ultrasonographic measures (bladder neck-symphysis distance and retrovesical angle during Valsalva), and abnormal fatigue degree of type II muscle fibres were identified as independent risk factors for postpartum SUI, with combined clinical, ultrasonographic, and myoelectric factors showing optimal predictive performance.
mod_finding: Assisted vaginal birth was more associated with postpartum SUI than cesarean birth in primipara subgroups.
